visualReview: Completed. All 182 positions were inspected in the three labeled contact sheets at original resolution. No obvious wrong, blank, corrupt, or name-mismatched artwork was found.
reviewMethod: Each current catalog image was fetched from its public Steam URL or read from its local public path, decoded, checked for visible pixels, placed in a labeled sheet, and opened with view_image.
limitations: This checks current catalog artwork, not the live-client shop order or item availability.
The review did not launch the Dota client or compare every icon against an independent client capture.
Small source PNGs were enlarged for inspection; the originals were not edited.

localIconChecks.observation: Purple book with a bright rune. The Phylactery label matches the displayed artwork.
Magenta blade. The visible item name is Khanda; angels_demise is the catalog key.
Cyan ornate blade. The Disperser label matches the displayed artwork.
